svg.title: Happy birthday, Trap — Arcade's graffiti mural
svg.desc: 140 approved hand-painted covers by 140 people. Each painting includes its original birthday wish in its description.
svg.metadata: Snapshot 8293ad0adab0fd5a. Saved 2026-11-10T14:24:38.001Z. Original vector strokes; no external assets.

g.title: Tyune
g.desc: Happy birthday, pretty girl! May your days always be filled with love, laughter, and all the little things that make your heart happy Stay lovely🎀

g.title: ijenys
g.desc: Happy birthday, TRAP! 🥳 Even though we don’t really know each other yet, hope you have an amazing birthday and a great year ahead. Wishing you all the best and enjoy your day! 🎂

g.title: chuwe
g.desc: Happy birthday, hexceptional Trap! may your day be louder than a hextech explosion💅🏻

g.title: ishtf
g.desc: Hi trap, hope you're trapped with success, happiness and joy :)

g.title: Ruby_927
g.desc:
To Trap 🎀, May your day be filled with love, joy, and all the little things that make you happiest✨️. Wishing you a year of beautiful memories, endless laughter, and dreams come true 💠.
A Dearest Happy Birthday! 🎂

g.title: Xunia
g.desc: Happy birthday Trap 🎂 Hope the best things for you in life and may your joy stay abundant in this day, and the many others that you will have to encounter 🤍 may you be blessed and thrive in whatever you put your heart into!! Happy birthday 🥳 enjoy

g.title: reformnew64
g.desc: "May your birthday inspire you to create a life as beautiful as yours. Happy Birthday Trap!"

g.title: QQB
g.desc:
May the year ahead be filled with success, growth, and unforgettable surprises. I hope you find peace in quiet moments, strength in challenges, and joy in all the little things that make life beautiful.
I also wish you and Wytie nothing but happiness, endless love, and countless beautiful memories together.
But most importantly, I hope you have a truly amazing birthday. Enjoy your special day to the fullest!

g.title: FreakyDevil
g.desc: Happy birthday Trap ! 🎂 Hope you have the loveliest day and an even better year ahead. May life bring you endless happiness, peace, and everything you've been wishing for 🎉
